name: Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski St. Moritz
insider_take: Where Alpine grandeur meets legendary luxury in the heart of Switzerland's most glamorous mountain resort.
whats_special: This Belle Époque masterpiece sits at 6,000 feet elevation and originally opened in 1896 as Europe's first luxury mountain resort hotel. The property features the world's only natural sparkling mineral water spa fed by the historic Mauritius spring, plus breathtaking views of Lake St. Moritz and the Engadin Valley. As a member of The Kempinski Club 1897 Program, guests enjoy access to exclusive amenities across the collection's most prestigious properties.
pro_tip: Book during the legendary White Turf horse races on the frozen lake (February) - the hotel offers prime viewing terraces and exclusive race day packages that sell out months in advance.
dont_miss: The hotel's historic Kempinski Spa with its mineral-rich Alpine treatments, and sunset cocktails on the lakefront terrace overlooking the iconic leaning tower of St. Moritz. Winter guests should experience the hotel's private access to the Corviglia ski slopes, while summer visitors can enjoy the nearby hiking trails that inspired countless writers and artists of the Romantic era.
pros: Prestigious Kempinski luxury brand with exceptional service standards
Prime St. Moritz location with stunning Alpine mountain views
Access to exclusive Kempinski Club 1897 Program benefits
cons: Seasonal operation in exclusive resort destination
